The '''captain''' of the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith]] [[Interdictor-class cruiser|''Interdictor''-class cruiser]] ''[[Dying Sun]]'' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served under the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Glovoc]] toward the end of the [[Jedi Civil War]]. The [[Captain/Legends|captain]] served as the commander of the ''Dying Sun'' during an expedition to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan]] in the [[Luire system]], which was prompted by a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] Glovoc received earlier. Once the ''Dying Sun'' reached its destination, the captain entered Glovoc's chambers, and was surprised when the Sith Lord did not subject him to a slow death for intruding upon his meditation. The ''Dying Sun'' was soon fired upon by a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] fleet and shot down over Nyriaan, where the ship's surviving crew eked out an existence under the leadership of Darth Glovoc.
